findings.claim: 研華 2026-03 法說會宣示 2026 年核心品牌策略為「Edge Computing & AI-Powered WISE Solutions」，並深化軟硬整合、打造彈性可擴充的邊緣方案平台；該發布未提及訂閱化或通路轉變。
findings.source: Advantech March 2026 investor conference news release (advantech.com)
findings.excerpt: the Company will adopt "Edge Computing & AI-Powered WISE Solutions" as its core brand development strategy in 2026

channel_business_model_shift.note: 通路破壞／D2C／訂閱化的 2025-2026 具體證據未查到；訂閱化僅見 2022 計畫（WISE-IoT 轉訂閱、iEMS BU 先行），無近期營收進度數據。2026 法說會 URL 於搜尋結果中未能確認，故 url=null。
